title: CAMERA FURTHER OUT
why: His 10-20 order and picture: the default camera sits further from the pillager. The default dial goes from 1.3 to 1.05, matching the pillager size in his picture; a saved personal zoom stays as chosen.
now: The default camera is further out. Reset zoom returns to 105 percent.
